axes.tm_ip_safety: Trademark / IP safety — does framing accidentally enable wholesale clone of a real product, or expose YC wordmarks/logos? (5=safe, 1=hazardous)
axes.privacy_posture: PII / stealth-URL handling, ephemeral preview policy, opt-outs, residency (5=robust, 1=leaky)
axes.abuse_surface: Prompt injection resistance, output validation, kill-switch presence, rate-limit/quotas (5=hardened, 1=wide-open)
axes.compliance_hygiene: Stage-1 OSI license, public repo, banned-vendor adherence, originality rule (5=clean, 1=violating)
axes.blast_radius: If a deployed preview is defamatory/infringing/leaks, scope of damage (5=contained, 1=catastrophic)
axes.satire_discipline: Whether the persona narrative stays categorical vs naming specific YC entities (5=disciplined, 1=names-and-shames)

scores.rp_notes: CLI+email surface narrows public attack surface and reduces SEO indexing of generated previews. BUT `curl whyc.sh -d url=...` with no auth = trivial abuse vector (ddos, prompt-injection JD floods, free Cloud Run-as-relay). No kill-switch shown. Email delivery of Cloud Run URLs to anyone who supplies an email = phishing-vector enabler.

Internal NOC dashboard = no public-facing IP/TM exposure. Operator-only persona means audit log, regen-budget alerts, kill-switch are first-class. Phoenix trace alerting = anomaly detection covers prompt-injection / runaway-generation. Lowest blast radius of the 26: the surface itself is the safety harness. SAFE PICK.

'No signup for first preview' + 'paste midnight' + emphasis on speed over validation = abuse magnet. No mention of TTL on Cloud Run URLs, opt-out, or origin checks. workatastartup.com URL paste = scraping someone else's pre-Demo-Day stealth posting at scale. RISKY.

Free-tier obsession + scale-to-zero = good for cost, BUT 'min-instances=0' + 'free Phoenix tier' implies the $0.04 receipt is publishable, encouraging viral abuse. PDF receipt with Cloud Run URL on it is a doxx vector if real YC URL was input. Compliance: free-tier Phoenix may not meet residency.

Hero-only screen = minimal user input surface = small abuse footprint. Explicit 'abstract inline-SVG product imagery (no real logos)' + 'YC-orange parody as accent' = TM-aware. 'animated preview-window' is a contained component, not a real Cloud Run URL exposure on the demo. Strong satire discipline.

VC-grade ranking grid of 'YC portfolio companies sorted by build velocity' = legal-disparagement landmine. Even with 'YC-A1F2' codenames, a publicly-rankable spec-fit % per real company is defamatory-by-implication. 'jobs-posted' column + 'days-since-DemoDay' makes the codename re-identifiable in 30s. VETO-CANDIDATE.

Thumb-zone friction-removal applied to roasting real companies = exactly the impulse-abuse pattern. Push notifications + clipboard paste of a tweeted JD = social retaliation surface. No login = no abuse-history accountability.

VC partner Slack + portfolio company URLs = NDA-territory data flowing through Gemini + Phoenix Cloud externally. /whyc <yc-url> in #portfolio = automated diligence on portfolio without consent. Slack unfurls auto-publish Cloud Run URLs into channel = leak path. Significant material-NPI / privacy concern. VETO-CANDIDATE.

npx + brew = signed-package supply-chain: legitimate. Browser callback for auth gives a real auth boundary (vs P01 unauthenticated curl). Desktop-notify on convergence = local. Backgrounded loop is per-user, not multi-tenant. Reasonable risk profile.

'200-company batch from a single dashboard' + 'pre-deploys variants before you ask' = mass-generation of unsolicited previews of real companies. Zero consent model. 'cross-portfolio meta-learning' = persistent scrape of YC universe. Hackathon scope-creep + scope-violates the 4-day deadline + maximum legal exposure. STRONG VETO-CANDIDATE.

Hardcoded fixture for the 4-day cut + single run-detail page = ZERO real-input attack surface during demo. Spec-fit chart is the entire product. 'Hackathon · 12/50 runs' rate-limit visible. The boring Postgres+SSE+Cloud Run shape is the safest possible shipping shape. LOWEST RISK, HIGHEST DEFENSIBILITY. SAFE PICK.

EXPLICITLY designs around every concern in this brief: client-side encryption, region-pinning, 24h signed-URL Cloud Run with image-TTL, self-hosted Phoenix opt-out (kills the 'OpenInference traces leave to Phoenix Cloud' surface), redaction manifest. ADK disableDataLogging is a real GCP control. Threat model is the product. SAFE PICK + threat-model gold.

Phoenix-trace dashboard for one in-flight run. 'Single run' scoping limits blast radius. Token-cost transparency is a positive control. 'Screenshot the convergence chart as their flex' = social proof of real receipts, low TM exposure. Demo-track with replay seems demonstrable safely.

'synthetic JD URL' for the demo = no real-company exposure. Tooltip-narration model implicitly limits attack scope to the educational walkthrough. Reasonable shape, though tooltips that explain 'why this LLM-as-judge prompt' could leak prompt-engineering IP — minor.

Public roast wall of YC companies + voting + comments + 'cohort rooms per YC batch' = textbook coordinated-disparagement platform. UGC moderation burden for a 2-person team is impossible. Multi-user content liability without DMCA process. Plus 'paste a JD' from any visitor = prompt-injection vector at scale. STRONGEST VETO-CANDIDATE.

'Paste your own pitch' = self-as-target completely removes YC-company-as-target risk. Single-account, one-Google-login, owner==admin==user = no multi-tenant risk. Explicit budget cap + Kill switch + quiet hours = abuse-controls baked into UX. Self-targeting reframes the satire from external attack to internal validation. SAFEST card on the slate. SAFE PICK.

SAML/SCIM/SOC2 controls are real positives for privacy. BUT 'corporate-VC diligence accelerator' producing 'auditor-ready dossiers' on YC prospects = creating a written record per company that could be subpoenaed or leaked from corp-VC. SOC2/SAML is unbuildable in 36 days = false-promise compliance posture. Persona crosses Stage-2 'unrealistic claims' threshold.

Synthetic case + 4 frozen iframe snapshots = sandboxed, no live URL submission risk for the demo. Scroll-story is one-way content (user as reader). 'YC-orange typographic indictment' is the categorically-correct satire format. Geometric YC-orange parody mark explicitly avoids wordmark. Solid.

SDK that 'any host can embed' to hit `whyc.generate(yc_url)` = supply-chain weaponization. Zero ability to control how downstream callers use it. Webhook contract + idempotent job handle = automated mass-generation primitive. 2-person team cannot maintain SDK abuse-policy + auth + ratelimit. Worst abuse profile.

OSI license + Apache-2.0 explicitly addresses Stage-1. README-as-landing has minimal input-receiving surface. 'fork our judge prompts' = open-sourcing the LLM-as-judge prompts could leak proprietary eval methodology, but for a hackathon repo this is policy-aligned. 'a certain orange accelerator' wording is the right satire register. Reasonable.

Stripe Checkout + 3-tier pricing = collecting payment info on hackathon timeline = PCI scope creep. Hackathon submission selling subscriptions to roast YC companies = both a Stripe TOS issue (illegal/abusive content review) AND an originality issue (productized commercial offering pre-launch). Card-data + Cloud Run URLs in same tenant boundary.

'Synthetic post-Demo-Day cohort' = no real-company data needed. Citation-grade prose + dataset bundle MIT-licensed (note: must verify MIT vs Apache for OSI-Stage-1, both qualify). Abstract+Figure+Table format is the academically-safe register. BUT 'Cohen's κ' is invented stat — Stage-2 honesty risk if numbers aren't real. Watch the auto-generated 'realistic statistics' line — that's a fabrication risk.

'Draft stalled YC companies' as a player draft pool + 'Out-shipped a Series A' badge + public leaderboard = explicitly turning real companies into game-pieces with status-currency awarded for mockery. Categorical satire is dead the moment a draft card has a name. Identical defamation profile to P15 + adds gamification rewarding it. STRONGEST VETO-CANDIDATE alongside P10/P15.

'Refuses to publish the deploy URL until disclosure is attached' = honesty-as-gate is genuinely a safety control. Public known-failures log = transparency reduces blast radius. Comparison-table register stays at category level (vs 'one-shot codegen') not at YC-name level. Strong defensive posture.

Conversational chat surface + @mention command palette injecting mid-flight corrections = MAXIMUM prompt-injection surface. The chat IS the prompt; user-supplied JD URL content goes straight into the agent context with no sanitation layer. 'Stream-of-consciousness Gemini tokens' = trace-leak by design. Worst abuse_surface among the 26.

'No chat, no sparkles, no model names, no streaming token flicker on the surface' = deterministic UX explicitly limits prompt-injection blast on the surface. Single-text-field + one-button + status-pill = minimal attack surface by design. Anti-AI minimalism + categorical-only YC-orange parody = the satire stays disciplined exactly because the product never theatricalizes. SAFE PICK.

top5_rationale.P11: Hardcoded-fixture demo path = literally zero live attack surface during the 4-day cut, while still proving the killer feature (spec-fit climb). Lowest demo-day risk.
top5_rationale.P16: Self-as-target reframes the entire risk model: paste your own pitch, not a YC company's. Kill-switch + budget-cap + quiet-hours are first-class UX. Removes defamation/TM risk almost entirely.
top5_rationale.P12: The only persona that explicitly threat-models the data-egress problem (Phoenix Cloud, Gemini, Cloud Run) and offers concrete mitigations (client-side enc, self-hosted Phoenix, signed 24h URLs). Threat model is the product.
top5_rationale.P02: Operator-only NOC dashboard means no public roast surface at all; alerts, audit log, and runbooks make the loop monitorable. Internal tool = minimal blast radius.
top5_rationale.P26: Deterministic UI + one-input/one-output + no chat = smallest prompt-injection surface among public-facing personas. Categorical satire stays disciplined because the product never theatricalizes.

chair_vote.rationale: Among the five top-ranked safe picks, P16 (The Solo Founder) is the only one that structurally eliminates the highest-severity risks for this product class — TM exposure of real YC companies and defamation by implication — by reframing the input from 'YC company URL' to 'your own pitch'. That single design choice converts WhyC from an externally-pointed roast tool into an internally-validated overnight build agent. The YC satire becomes brand framing on the marketing surface, not the runtime input contract — which is exactly the safety rail the hackathon trademark constraint and the categorical-satire rule both want. P16 also bakes in three abuse-controls (budget cap, quiet hours, Kill switch) that no other top-5 card has explicitly. P11 is a close second purely on demo-day attack-surface, but P16 is the better foundation for the actual product.

veto_decisions.veto_threshold_review: RP_LEAD reviewed Risk Veto authority for P10 (Dreamer mass-batch generation), P15 (Community Builder public roast wall), P23 (Game Designer YC-as-draft-pool), P06 (Spreadsheet Jockey portfolio ranking), and P08 (Slack-Native VC partner channel). All five score below 2.20 weighted and exhibit at least one of: (a) wholesale YC-company naming/identification at scale, (b) UGC moderation burden infeasible for 2-person team, (c) NDA/material-NPI flow through external trace surface, (d) gamification of disparagement. However, since none of these five are in the chair-recommended top-5 AND meta-tally is expected to deprioritize them on other axes too, formal Veto is NOT invoked at this stage. RP_LEAD reserves Veto for re-invocation if any of {P06, P08, P10, P15, P23} appears in the meta-tally final-3 selection — at which point M3 escalation + AskUserQuestion is mandatory.

dissent_must_fix: P15/P23/P10: do NOT advance — public roast walls / YC-as-draft-pool / 200-co mass-gen create coordinated-disparagement liability for 2-person team.
P06/P08: portfolio-ranking grid + Slack-channel /whyc on real YC URLs = NDA + material-NPI leak path; treat as veto-eligible if surfaced.
Generated previews MUST ship with 24h-signed-URL TTL + noindex + robots.txt deny — Cloud Run defaults will get archived by IA/Google.
JD URL input MUST go through prompt-injection sanitizer (delimiter-isolation + system-prompt hardening) before Gemini call — non-negotiable.
OSI license: confirm Apache-2.0 OR MIT in repo root before Stage-1 — current spec says 'OSI-approved' not specific; pick one early.
Demo video: synthetic JD only, no workatastartup.com IDs visible, no YC-orange used as logo (accent only), README scrubbed of company names.
Phoenix Cloud trace egress: document data residency in README + provide self-host instructions (P12 pattern) — judges will ask.
Kill switch: every advancing persona must define how a generated preview gets taken down within 1h of complaint — currently only P16 has it.
Originality rule: all code dated >=2026-05-05; verify no preview-forge plugin code reuse; commit log must prove this — Stage-1 disqualifier.
Banned-vendor check: no AWS / OpenAI / Anthropic in agent backbone; CI lint for forbidden import paths before submission.
Trademark: YC-orange is parody, but 'WHILE YC HIRES' uses 'YC' wordmark in headline copy — categorical-satire defense weakens; consider 'while they hire' as substitution.
P21 paid-SaaS framing introduces PCI scope on hackathon timeline — drop monetization from MVP; revisit post-submission only.
P22 'realistic statistics (μ, σ, κ)' must be REAL numbers from real runs, not Opus-generated plausible figures — research-fraud risk.
Abuse case: rate-limit per-IP and per-email on any public-input surface; cap concurrent Cloud Run deploys at 3 to prevent quota-DoS.
Two-person on-call: define who responds within 24h to a 'this preview defames us, take it down' email — currently undefined.

veto_escalation_protocol.trigger: If meta-tally surfaces any of [P06, P08, P10, P15, P23] in the final selection
veto_escalation_protocol.action: RP_LEAD invokes Risk Veto, escalates to M3 Dev PM, AskUserQuestion presents safer alternatives from top-5
